episodes.synopsis: Anne and Grea are chitchatting during school breakfast, when an incident in the library forces Anne to leave her and try to fix it.
episodes.title: Anne and Grea

episodes.synopsis: Grea is suddenly struck with a high fever and Anne goes through the "forbidden" archives of the library trying to find a way to cure her.
episodes.title: Agony of Grea

episodes.synopsis: Anne and Grea spend the day shopping in town.
episodes.title: Princess’s Holiday

episodes.synopsis: It is exam time at the school, and with everyone studying, Anne does not get to spend a lot of time with Grea.
episodes.title: Test Time

episodes.synopsis: Monsters suddenly attack the school from within, and Anne sneaks in to find and rescue Grea.
episodes.title: Academy Down

episodes.synopsis: While the rest of the class is having fun at the beach, Anne and Grea go on their own private adventure.
episodes.title: Floating at Sea

episodes.synopsis: Anne and Grea are on library duty and, in order to pass the time, they decide to play a game of hide-and-seek.
episodes.title: Hide-and-Seek

episodes.synopsis: When stage fright gets the better of Grea, it’s up to Anne to calm her down and save the school play. The show must go on!
episodes.title: Backstage Confidential

episodes.synopsis: A simple misunderstanding opens a rift in Anne and Grea’s friendship. Will they be able to overcome this hurdle, or will it derail their relationship entirely?
episodes.title: A Slice of Life

episodes.synopsis: It’s the end of the school term, and everyone is heading home. Parting is such sweet sorrow — especially for Grea and Anne.
episodes.title: The Pair's Promise
